_comment: Per-call presentation metadata. daysAgo/timeOfDay are resolved to real dates at render time rather than baked in, so the library always reads as a live account ('Today', 'Yesterday') whenever someone opens the deployed link, instead of decaying into a wall of stale dates.

calls.note: The stress case: large group call, heavy crosstalk, 1h49m. Today, so it is the first thing a reviewer sees.
